scope: Reusable blank requirement workflow and canonical public facts only; private requirements, imports and Elastic trial excluded.

version-release-watch: SAIA/ITSI public prerequisite sections and discovery
es-editions-watch: ES edition, deployment, model, enablement and prerequisite scopes
csp-fedramp-watch: Exact feature/provider/region and regulated scopes; no inheritance from base-assistant scope
version-guidance-audit: Independent admission, contradiction, expiry, negative, privacy, migration and export checks

requiredDisposition: Every declared participating run reports applicable record/source scopes as assessed-changed, assessed-unchanged, blocked, not-due or not-applicable with actual evidence. Retrieval alone is not assessment.
admission: Changed, unavailable or overdue dependency scopes fail closed. Pin updates require explicit scoped review and traceable diff. Canonical claim, source, section and typed-rule assessment dates stay separate.

activation.readback: Required before claiming any future prompt amendment; preserve cadence, timezone, enabled state, permissions and caps.
activation.firstRealRun: Required before claiming scheduled responsibility for replacement.
activation.privateCandidateReview: Does not require full independent active-delivery rollout or scheduled-responsibility activation.
activation.publication: Separate explicit approval; current publisher hold unchanged.

privacy: Public-source watches receive no customer brief or import. No new telemetry, endpoint, API credential, timer, budget or private collection.
rollback: Retain original Advisor and URL reader until separately verified route activation. Preserve the prior complete verified bundle for restore; no automatic deployment or date rollback.
